abstract: BACKGROUND: To review the experience of seven cases of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia with central nervous system involvement. METHODS: Seven patients among 50 cases of malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia were analyzed retrospectively in a single institution. RESULTS: The mean age of the patients at diagnosis was 28.7 years (range: 20-34). While five of the patients presented initially with symptoms related to cranial involvement, the remaining two developed cerebral metastases during the therapy. In two patients, the presentation was so similar to a primary cranial pathology that craniotomy and biopsy revealed the trophoblastic involvement. The sites of involvement were the parietal lobe in three, temporal lobe in two and frontal lobe in two patients. Besides central nervous system involvement, four had additional lung and one had pelvic metastases. In terms of therapy, while five patients received methotrexate+actinomycin-D+cyclophosphamide regimen for 3 to 5 courses, only two could be administered additional intrathecal methotrexate. Since one patient exhibited a fulminant clinical course, she could not be delivered a chemotherapy regimen and was lost in two months of initial diagnosis. The other patient was administered modified Bagshawe protocol (5 courses) which was switched to etoposide+methotrexate+actinomycin-D+vincristine+cyclophosphamide (6 courses) due to development of resistance. She was still alive and free of disease after 24 months of initial diagnosis. Six of the patients were also delivered whole-brain irradiation simultaneously with chemotherapy. CONCLUSIONS: The prognosis of brain metastases still seems to be poor despite combination chemotherapy and radiotherapy. Measures should be focused on early diagnosis and prophylaxis.
abstract_ja: 背景：悪性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍50例のうち、中枢神経系病変を有した7例の経験を検討する。方法：単一施設において、悪性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍50例のうち7例を後方視的に解析した。結果：診断時の平均年齢は28.7歳（範囲：20〜34歳）であった。5例は初診時に頭蓋内病変に関連する症状で発症し、残る2例は治療中に大脳転移を生じた。2例では原発性頭蓋内病変との臨床像の類似性が高く、開頭術と生検により絨毛性病変の浸潤が確認された。病変部位は、頭頂葉が3例、側頭葉が2例、前頭葉が2例であった。中枢神経系病変に加え、4例では肺転移、1例では骨盤内転移を認めた。治療に関しては、5例がメトトレキサート＋アクチノマイシンD＋シクロホスファミドレジメンを3〜5コース受けた。髄腔内メトトレキサート投与を追加できたのは2例のみであった。1例は急速に劇症化し、化学療法を施行できずに初診から2か月以内に死亡した。もう1例はBagshaweプロトコールを5コース施行された後、耐性出現のためエトポシド＋メトトレキサート＋アクチノマイシンD＋ビンクリスチン＋シクロホスファミドに変更され（6コース）、初診から24か月の時点で生存し無病であった。6例では化学療法と同時に全脳照射も施行された。結論：脳転移の予後は、併用化学療法と放射線療法を行っても依然不良である。早期診断と予防に重点を置くべきである。
